Model fit showcase

Gilles Lijnzaad

2026-11-18

In this document, I explain the code for my standard Stan model of the climate-RL task (without confirmation bias) and demonstrate parameter recovery.

Helper files

In this R markdown I use code from the following files: sim_utils.R, plot_utils.R, fit_utils.R, and utils.R.

1 Creating the data

1.1 Running the simulation

rm(list = ls())
setwd("~/research/climate-RL-mod/2_modeling_showcase")
main_dir <- "~/research/climate-RL-mod/"
util_dir <- paste0(main_dir, "9_utilities/")
mod_dir <- paste0(main_dir, "0_models/")
model_path <- paste0(mod_dir, "1_std.stan")

sim <- new.env()
source(paste0(mod_dir, "1_std.R"), local = sim)
params <- list(
  n_part = 50,
  n_trials = 30,
  LR_group = 0.4,
  inv_temp_group = 0.5,
  initQ_dev_group = 2,
  mu_R_group = 5.5,
  sigma_R_group = 2
)

sim_dat <- sim$run(params)

cat(paste0("PARAMETER SETTINGS:"), capture.output(dplyr::glimpse(params)), sep = "\n")

1.2 Inspecting the data

Just so I know what to expect of our model, I include plots of the simulated data: Q and choices over time.

plot <- new.env()
source(paste0(util_dir, "plot_utils.R"), local = plot)

plot$sim_plots(sim_dat, params)

2 Explaining the model

I show the Stan model code bit by bit to explain what is happening. The full code can be found in 1_std.stan.

2.1 data block

The data we supply to the model consist of:

  1. the number of participants: n_part;
  2. the number of trials per participant: n_trials;
  3. an array of choices that a participant made: choice_c[n_part, n_trials], coded as (1) consistent with the very first choice (hence choice_c) or (2) not consistent with the first choice;
  4. an array of ratings that a participant gave: R[n_part, n_trials]. These are analogous to the array outcomes[n_trials] in the 2arm_bandit_example (see Stan code for this example);
  5. the mean rating of a participant, as calculated from the data: mu_R[n_part].
mod_code <- readLines(model_path)
start <- grep("data \\{", mod_code)[1]
end <- grep("transformed data \\{", mod_code) - 2
cat(mod_code[start:end], sep = "\n")
data {
  int<lower=1> n_part;
  int<lower=1> n_trials;
  array[n_part, n_trials] int<lower=1, upper=2> choice_c;
  array[n_part, n_trials] int<lower=1, upper=10> R;
  vector<lower=1, upper=10>[n_part] mu_R;
}

2.2 transformed data block

Currently unused.

start <- grep("transformed data \\{", mod_code)
end <- grep("parameters \\{", mod_code)[1] - 2
cat(mod_code[start:end], sep = "\n")

2.3 parameters block

In the current model, we have three free parameters:

  1. learning rate LR;
  2. inverse temperature inv_temp;
  3. deviation from the mean for initial Q: initQ_dev. This is related to the actual initial Qs as:

initQ_pref = mu_R + initQ_dev initQ_nonpref = mu_R - initQ_dev

where mu_R is calculated from the data.

start <- grep("parameters \\{", mod_code)[1]
end <- grep("transformed parameters \\{", mod_code) - 2
cat(mod_code[start:end], sep = "\n")
parameters {
  // group-level parameters
  vector[3] means_probit;
  vector<lower=0>[3] sigmas;

  // participant-level parameters
  vector[n_part] LR_probit;
  vector[n_part] inv_temp_probit;
  vector[n_part] initQ_dev_probit;
}

2.4 transformed parameters block

Currently unused.

start <- grep("transformed parameters \\{", mod_code)
end <- grep("model \\{", mod_code) - 2
cat(mod_code[start:end], sep = "\n")

2.5 model block

2.5.1 The priors

[explanation here]

start <- grep("model \\{", mod_code)
end <- grep("participant loop", mod_code)[1] - 2
cat(mod_code[start:end], sep = "\n")
model {
  // priors
  means_probit ~ normal(0, 1);
  sigmas ~ normal(0, 0.2);
  
  LR_probit ~ normal(0, 1);
  inv_temp_probit ~ normal(0, 1);
  initQ_dev_probit ~ normal(0, 1);

2.5.2 Participant loop

[explanation here]

start <- grep("participant loop", mod_code) + 1
end <- grep("trial loop", mod_code) - 2
cat(mod_code[start:end], sep = "\n")
  for (j in 1:n_part) {
    
    // initialization
    array[n_trials, 2] real Q;
    Q[1, 1] = mu_R[j] + initQ_dev[j];
    Q[1, 2] = mu_R[j] - initQ_dev[j];
    vector[2] Q_t;
    real pred_err;

2.5.3 Trial loop

start <- grep("trial loop", mod_code) + 1
end <- grep("generated quantities", mod_code) - 2
cat(mod_code[start:end], sep = "\n")
    for (t in 1:n_trials) {
      Q_t = to_vector(Q[t]);

      // sample choice (1 is pref, 2 is nonpref) via softmax
      // but not for trial 1
      if (t > 1) {
        choice_c[j, t] ~ categorical_logit(inv_temp[j] * Q_t);
      }

      // prediction error
      pred_err = R[j, t] - Q[t, choice_c[j, t]];

      // update value (learn)
      if (t < n_trials) {    // no updating in the very last trial
        if (choice_c[j, t] == 1) {
          Q[t+1, 1] = Q[t, 1] + LR[j] * pred_err;
          Q[t+1, 2] = Q[t, 2];
        } else {
          Q[t+1, 1] = Q[t, 1];
          Q[t+1, 2] = Q[t, 2] + LR[j] * pred_err;
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

2.6 generated quantities block

[explanation here]

start <- grep("generated quantities", mod_code)
end <- length(mod_code)
cat(mod_code[start:end], sep = "\n")
generated quantities {
  vector[3] means;
  means[1] = Phi_approx(means_probit[1]); // LR_group
  means[2] = Phi_approx(means_probit[2]) * 5; // inv_temp_group
  means[3] = Phi_approx(means_probit[3]) * 10; // initQ_dev_group
}

3 Fitting the model

3.1 Single run: chosen parameters

3.1.1 Do the run

dat_dir <- paste0(main_dir, "3_param_recovery/1_std/1_run/")
dat_file <- paste0(dat_dir, "dat_001.json")

fitting <- new.env()
source(paste0(util_dir, "fit_utils.R"), local = fitting)
model <- cmdstan_model(model_path)
free_params_group <- c("LR_group", "inv_temp_group", "initQ_dev_group")
draws <- fitting$fit(model, dat_file, return = "draws", free_params = free_params_group, show_iteration_progress = TRUE)
## Running MCMC with 1 chain...
## 
## Chain 1 Iteration:    1 / 1500 [  0%]  (Warmup) 
## Chain 1 Iteration:  200 / 1500 [ 13%]  (Warmup) 
## Chain 1 Iteration:  400 / 1500 [ 26%]  (Warmup) 
## Chain 1 Iteration:  501 / 1500 [ 33%]  (Sampling) 
## Chain 1 Iteration:  700 / 1500 [ 46%]  (Sampling) 
## Chain 1 Iteration:  900 / 1500 [ 60%]  (Sampling) 
## Chain 1 Iteration: 1100 / 1500 [ 73%]  (Sampling) 
## Chain 1 Iteration: 1300 / 1500 [ 86%]  (Sampling) 
## Chain 1 Iteration: 1500 / 1500 [100%]  (Sampling) 
## Chain 1 finished in 36.3 seconds.
saveRDS(draws, paste0(dat_dir, "draws.rds"))

3.1.2 Group-level parameters

draws <- readRDS(paste0(dat_dir, "draws.rds"))
p <- plot$posterior_densities(draws, free_params_group, params)
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(p)

util <- new.env()
source(paste0(util_dir, "utils.R"), local = util)
to_inspect <- free_params_group
util$print_posterior_table(draws, params, to_inspect)
